40023085.author: पदार्थः
40023085.content: कस्यचित् of some, तु indeed, अथ then, कालस्य of time, रामे while Rama, धर्मपरे devoted to righteousness, स्थिते was abiding, कालः Time, तापसरूपेण in the form of an ascetic, राजद्वारम् to the royal gate, उपागमत् approached.

40023085.author: Translation
40023085.content: Then, after some time, while Rama was abiding devoted to righteousness, Time, in the form of an ascetic, approached the royal gate.

40023086.author: पदार्थः
40023086.content: सः he, अब्रवीत् spoke, लक्ष्मणं to Lakshmana, वाक्यं words, धृतिमन्तं resolute, यशश्विनम् glorious, मां me, निवेदय announce, रामाय to Rama, सम्प्राप्तं arrived, कार्यगौरवात् due to the importance of the matter.

40023086.author: Translation
40023086.content: He spoke to the resolute and glorious Lakshmana, saying, "Announce my arrival to Rama, as I have come due to the grave importance of my mission."

40023087.author: पदार्थः
40023087.content: दूतः a messenger, अस्मि I am, अतिबलस्य of the very powerful, अहं I, महर्षेः of the great sage, अमितौजसः of immeasurable energy, रामं Rama, दिदृक्षुः desirous of seeing, आयातः arrived, कार्येण for a purpose, हि indeed, महाबल O mighty one.

40023087.author: Translation
40023087.content: "O mighty one, I am indeed a messenger of a very powerful great sage of immeasurable energy, and I have arrived desirous of seeing Rama for an important purpose."

40023088.author: पदार्थः
40023088.content: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनं word, श्रुत्वा having heard, सौमित्रिः Lakshmana, त्वरया with haste, अन्वितः endowed, न्यवेदयत informed, रामाय to Rama, तापसं the ascetic, तं him, समागतम् arrived.

40023088.author: Translation
40023088.content: Having heard his words, Lakshmana, filled with haste, informed Rama about the arrival of that ascetic.

40023089.author: पदार्थः
40023089.content: जयस्व conquer, राम O Rama, धर्मेण by righteousness, उभौ both, लोकौ worlds, महाद्युते O greatly radiant one, दूतः a messenger, त्वां you, द्रष्टुम् to see, आगतः has come, तपसा by penance, भास्करप्रभः radiant like the sun.

40023089.author: Translation
40023089.content: O greatly radiant Rama, conquer both worlds through righteousness; a messenger, radiant like the sun due to his penance, has arrived to see you.

40023090.author: पदार्थः
40023090.content: तत् that, वाक्यं word, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, उक्तं spoken, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामः Rama, उवाच said, ह indeed, प्रवेश्यतां let him be admitted, मुनिः the sage, तात O dear one, महौजाः greatly powerful, तस्य his, वाक्यधृत् bearer of a message.

40023090.author: Translation
40023090.content: Having heard those words spoken by Lakshmana, Rama indeed said, "O dear one, let that greatly powerful sage, who is a bearer of a message, be admitted."

40023091.author: पदार्थः
40023091.content: सौमित्रिः Lakshmana, तु and, तथा so be it, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, प्रावेशयत led in, तं that, मुनिम् sage, ज्वलन्तम् blazing, एव indeed, तेजोभिः with splendors, प्रदहन्तम् burning, इव as if, अंशुभिः with rays.

40023091.author: Translation
40023091.content: And Lakshmana, having said "So be it," led in that sage who was blazing with his own splendor, as if burning with rays of light.

40023092.author: पदार्थः
40023092.content: सः he, अभिगम्य having approached, रघुश्रेष्ठं the best of the Raghus, दीप्यमानं shining, स्वतेजसा with his own splendor, ऋषिः the sage, मधुरया with sweet, वाचा voice, वर्धस्व may you prosper, इति thus, आह said, राघवम् to Rama.

40023092.author: Translation
40023092.content: Having approached Rama, the best of the Raghus, who was shining with his own splendor, the sage said to him with a sweet voice, "May you prosper."

40023093.author: पदार्थः
40023093.content: तस्मै to him, रामः Rama, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent one, पूजाम् honor, अर्घ्यपुरोगमाम् preceded by arghya, ददौ gave, कुशलम् welfare, अव्यग्रम् calmly, प्रष्टुम् to ask, एव indeed, उपचक्रमे began.

40023093.author: Translation
40023093.content: The greatly effulgent Rama offered him honor, preceded by arghya, and calmly began to inquire about his well-being.

40023094.author: पदार्थः
40023094.content: पृष्टः asked, च and, कुशलम् welfare, तेन by him, रामेण by Rama, वदतां वरः the best among speakers, आसने on the seat, काञ्चने golden, दिव्ये divine, निषसाद sat down, महायशाः the greatly renowned one.

40023094.author: Translation
40023094.content: And being asked about his welfare by Rama, the greatly renowned one, who was the best among speakers, sat down on a divine golden seat.

40023095.author: पदार्थः
40023095.content: तम् to him, उवाच said, ततः then, रामः Rama, स्वागतम् welcome, ते to you, महामुने O great sage, प्रापय deliver, अस्य his, च and, वाक्यानि words, यतः from whom, दूतः messenger, त्वम् you, आगतः have come.

40023095.author: Translation
40023095.content: Then Rama said to him, "Welcome to you, O great sage; please deliver the messages of him from whom you have come as a messenger."

40023096.author: पदार्थः
40023096.content: चोदितः urged, राजसिंहेन by the lion among kings, मुनिः the sage, वाक्यम् words, अभाषत spoke, द्वन्द्वम् a secret, एतत् this, प्रवक्तव्यम् to be spoken, हितम् beneficial, वै indeed, यदि if, अपेक्षसे you desire.

40023096.author: Translation
40023096.content: Urged by the lion among kings, the sage spoke these words: "This secret must be spoken if you indeed desire what is beneficial."

40023097.author: पदार्थः
40023097.content: यः whoever, शृणोति listens, निरीक्षेत् looks, वा or, सः he, वध्यः punishable by death, भविता will be, तव your, भवेत् it should be, वै indeed, मुनिमुख्यस्य of the chief of sages, वचनम् the word, यदि if, अपेक्षसे you desire.

40023097.author: Translation
40023097.content: Whoever listens or looks will be punishable by death by you, if you truly desire to heed the words of the chief of sages.

40023098.author: पदार्थः
40023098.content: सः He, तथा so, इति thus, प्रतिज्ञाय having promised, रामः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् spoke, द्वारि at the door, तिष्ठ stand, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, प्रतिहारम् the doorkeeper, विसर्जय dismiss.

40023098.author: Translation
40023098.content: Having agreed to the condition, Rama spoke to Lakshmana, instructing him to stand at the door and dismiss the doorkeeper.

40023099.author: पदार्थः
40023099.content: सः He, मे my, वध्यः one to be killed, खलु indeed, भवेत् would be, कथाद्वन्द्वम् the conversation of two, समीरितम् spoken, ऋषेः of the sage, मम and my, च and, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, पश्येत् sees, वा or, शृणुयात् hears, च and, यः who.

40023099.author: Translation
40023099.content: Rama declared that anyone who sees or hears the private conversation between him and the sage would indeed be worthy of death.

40023100.author: पदार्थः
40023100.content: ततः Then, निक्षिप्य having stationed, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha (Rama), लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, द्वारि at the door, सङ्ग्रहम् as a guard, तम् to him (the sage), उवाच spoke, मुने O sage, वाक्यम् the matter, कथयस्व tell, इति thus, राघवः Raghava (Rama).

40023100.author: Translation
40023100.content: Then, having stationed Lakshmana as a guard at the door, Rama (Kakutstha) spoke to the sage, saying, "O sage, please tell me the matter."

40023101.author: पदार्थः
40023101.content: यत् whatever, ते your, मनीषितम् desired, वाक्यम् message, येन by which, वा or, असि you are, समाहितः intent, कथयस्व tell, अविशङ्कः without hesitation, त्वम् you, मम my, अपि also, हृदि in heart, वर्तते it exists.

40023101.author: Translation
40023101.content: Rama urged the sage to speak without hesitation whatever message he desired or was intent upon, for a similar thought was also present in Rama's heart. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्र्युत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। 103 ।। Thus ends the hundred and third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
